tools.name: search_code_bricks
tools.description: Hybrid semantic (vector) and lexical (BM25 + AST filter) search across all indexed repositories to discover reusable classes, functions, and modules.

query.description: Natural language intent or exact symbol/signature query (e.g., 'thread-safe ring buffer' or 'fn parse_hl7').

min_portability.description: Filter out tightly coupled legacy code below this portability threshold.

tools.name: inspect_brick_contract
tools.description: Retrieve the AST signature, docstring, external package requirements, and internal dependency tree of a specific brick without loading its full implementation body (saves context window).

brick_id.description: Unique hash ID of the code brick.

tools.name: extract_composable_bundle
tools.description: Extract a code brick along with its transitive internal helper functions/types and required import headers as a self-contained, ready-to-compile code block.

brick_ids.description: One or more brick IDs to bundle together.

include_internal_deps.description: Automatically resolve and inline sibling helper functions/structs referenced in the AST.

strip_repo_specifics.description: Rewrite internal module paths to flat/local scope imports.

tools.name: compose_and_adapt_bricks
tools.description: Synthesize or refactor one or more catalog bricks to fit a target architecture, language version, or interface contract.

target_language.description: Target language (allows cross-language transpilation of logic bricks, e.g., Python to Rust).

integration_spec.description: Instructions on how the bricks should be wired together or adapted (e.g., 'Expose as an async FastAPI router' or 'Adapt struct to implement serde::Serialize').

tools.name: trigger_repo_sync
tools.description: Trigger an incremental Tree-sitter AST crawl and index update on a specific local path or registered repository.

path.description: Absolute local or network path to scan.
